criteria.text: An invoice's net total is the sum of quantity x unit price of its lines.
Standard VAT of 20% is applied to the net total and rounded half-up to the cent.
Customers flagged tax-exempt are charged no VAT, and the invoice shows the note "VAT exempt".
A percentage discount is applied before VAT.
A fixed discount larger than the net total brings the net to zero, never negative.
Issuing an invoice assigns the next number in the form INV-YYYY-NNNN and sets its status to issued.
An issued invoice cannot be edited: adding a line raises InvoiceLocked.
Voiding an issued invoice creates a credit note for the full gross amount.
Invoices not paid 30 days after issue are marked overdue.
Reminder emails for overdue invoices are sent at most once per week.

T01.name: test_line_total_is_quantity_times_price
T01.code:
def test_line_total_is_quantity_times_price():
    chairs = Line("Office chair, mesh back", 4, 18990)
    lamps = Line("Ergonomic desk lamp", 1, 3450)
    setup = Line("Setup (waived)", 1, 0)

    assert chairs.total == 4 * 18990
    assert lamps.total == 3450
    assert setup.total == 0

T02.name: test_net_is_sum_of_lines
T02.code:
def test_net_is_sum_of_lines(customer):
    inv = Invoice(customer)
    inv.add_line("Consulting, senior (hours)", 3, SENIOR_RATE)
    inv.add_line("Consulting, junior (hours)", 5, JUNIOR_RATE)
    inv.add_line("Travel flat fee", 1, TRAVEL_FEE)

    expected = 3 * SENIOR_RATE + 5 * JUNIOR_RATE + 1 * TRAVEL_FEE

    assert inv.net == expected
    assert inv.net == 70550

T03.name: test_unit_price_cannot_be_negative
T03.code:
def test_unit_price_cannot_be_negative(invoice):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        invoice.add_line("Goodwill refund", 1, -500)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Line("Goodwill refund", 3, -1)

    assert invoice.lines == []
